text:
deploy-bot: starting config-only rollout \u2014 geo-routing + batching tweak. Canary 10% for 30m. Change window 19:00-21:00 UTC. Patch: prefer eu-west, fallback us-east, batch_max_tokens=32, request_timeout_ms=1800. Posting health checks every 5m.

mira: quick context - pin eu traffic to model v2.1-quant (reason: latency stability), allow fallback to v2.1-8bit in other regions. No code changes.

sam: noted. should we exclude big-tenant-42 from canary to avoid burst noise?

noah: yes exclude big-tenant-42. also drain any host that hits OOMs automatically.

jia: telemetry thresholds: rollback if p99 > 1200ms or error_rate_delta > +2% compared to baseline. Also watch KV cache miss rate.

mira: agree to thresholds. I'll update release notes and pin list.

sam: small config snippet for ops reference:

```yaml
routing:
  region_policy: prefer
  prefer_regions: [eu-west-1]
  fallback_regions: [us-east-1]
batching:
  max_tokens: 32
  concurrency: 8
timeouts:
  request_ms: 1800
model_pin:
  eu-west-1: v2.1-quant
  fallback: v2.1-8bit
```

deploy-bot: canary started at 2026-03-22T19:02:25Z. Observability hooks enabled: /dash/per-route, ping @mira @jia on alerts.

(5m check) jia: p50 ~ 80ms eu, p99 ~ 950ms eu, error rate stable. KV cache miss up 0.4% - fine.

(12m) sam: one host reported model OOM and was drained by autoscaler, traffic routed away, no requester errors.

mira: bump canary to 25% after next green 10m check. Leave pin in place for eu-west.

jia: agreed. log a rollback playbook in case we hit thresholds: `/deploybot abort` to roll config back and `/deploybot pin-unwind` to remove model pins.

mira: release note draft: "Config-only: geo routing preference set to eu-west-1 with model pin v2.1-quant for EU canary; fallback to v2.1-8bit; batching tuned (max_tokens=32); request timeout 1800ms. Canary 10% -> 25% on green. Rollback conditions: p99>1200ms or error_rate_delta>2%. Excluded tenant big-tenant-42 from canary."

noah: :thumbsup: I'll be oncall during the change window and will trigger rollback if anything unexpected.

deploy-bot: next automated health post in 5m. Will attach perf traces and sample logs.
